explanation: Requested a 5-point scan of cos(theta*) from -1 to +1 at W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.5 GeV^2, phi*=90 deg for the eta channel. Preflight check flagged the two endpoints (cos_theta*=-1 and +1) as FAIL because the code cannot evaluate exactly at the kinematic poles; the interior points (-0.5, 0, 0.5) passed. Applied the standard fix of clamping the endpoints to +/-0.999, which is the accepted convention for this code, then regenerated and re-validated all 5 points (all PASS). Input file written for the 5-point scan (-0.999, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 0.999) at the CLAS12 RG-K beam energy (6.53 GeV), the campaign this eta table was validated against.
